description:
Who We Are

Work Location: This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Arizona, California, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Missouri, New York, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, or Washington.

EZ Texting has spent more than 20 years helping businesses connect with their customers through text messaging. In 2026, we made a significant shift in how we operate, embracing AI as an opportunity to rethink how we build products, serve customers, and get work done.

We moved to a leaner, faster operating model, organized around outcomes rather than traditional departmental boundaries. Our focus is on building a smarter, more self-sufficient product while giving our people the tools, autonomy, and accountability to solve meaningful problems.

We're bringing the experience of an established SaaS company together with the speed and mindset of a startup. There's plenty we're still figuring out, and that's part of the work ahead.

How We Work

AI generates work. People own outcomes and create leverage.

AI is embedded in how we operate. We use it to challenge our thinking, accelerate execution, improve decisions, and create more capacity for meaningful work.

We expect people to work independently, look beyond the boundaries of their job descriptions, and take ownership of problems rather than waiting for direction. We move quickly, test ideas, learn from what works and what doesn't, and keep improving.

AI expands what we can accomplish, but human judgment and accountability remain essential. Our people are responsible for validating the work, making sound decisions, and owning the results.

Your Mission

Drive more Demand (Paid & Organic) and Turn more of the traffic into paying customers.

At EZ Texting, we're looking for an experienced marketing strategist who can independently diagnose performance challenges, identify growth opportunities, and shape how we acquire and convert customers. You'll lead conversion strategy across paid and organic channels, using performance insights to determine where to invest, what to improve, and when to change course. You'll direct execution through agencies, specialists, and AI-enabled workflows, with accountability for stronger conversion rates, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

On the organic side, you'll work with our SEO partner to develop and execute strategies that improve visibility across traditional search (SEO) and AI-generated answers, including Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT (GEO). The focus is on translating that visibility into qualified traffic and paying customers.

You'll use AI throughout the marketing lifecycle, from research and campaign development to experimentation, analysis, and optimization. You'll also identify opportunities to improve and automate existing processes, using your marketing expertise and judgment to ensure those improvements translate into better performance.

What You'll Own

  • Conversion Ownership & Orchestration: Own conversion strategy and performance across paid and organic acquisition channels. Independently identify funnel inefficiencies, establish optimization priorities, and recommend improvements based on customer behavior, performance data, and commercial impact.

  • Campaign Strategy & Execution: Develop integrated acquisition strategies and direct execution through agencies, offshore specialists, and AI agents. Evaluate channel performance, challenge assumptions, and recommend strategic adjustments to marketing leadership.

  • Organic Growth (SEO & GEO): Work with our SEO vendor to develop and run the strategy that grows organic visibility and volume, across traditional search and AI answer engines such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Set priorities, review the work, and tie organic results to conversions and NPUs.

  • Site Content, Landing Pages, Offers & Creative: Direct high-converting landing pages, ad creative, messaging and offers. Use AI for research, first drafts and variants, and your own judgment to decide what ships.

  • Experimentation & Optimization: Establish a disciplined approach to A/B Testing across campaigns, landing pages, offers, and conversion funnels. Develop hypotheses, evaluate results, and prioritize opportunities based on business impact and supporting evidence.

  • AI-Enabled Operations: Build and improve AI-assisted workflows for research, creative production, reporting, attribution and optimization. Know where AI helps, where it needs human review, and how to measure the difference.

  • Measurement & Sales Alignment: Connect acquisition performance to downstream conversion, customer quality, and revenue outcomes. Partner with sales and customer-facing teams to identify friction, improve lead quality, and inform broader growth priorities.

  • Content Strategy & Editorial Oversight: Direct and refine conversion-focused messaging across website content, landing pages, advertising, and creative. Own final editorial review and approval of content produced by agencies, specialists, and AI, ensuring everything published is accurate, clear, consistent, and aligned with our brand.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in growth or performance marketing, or equivalent experience, with a track record of owning acquisition strategy and driving measurable growth in paying customers and revenue.

  • You've managed paid and organic acquisition across search, social, and other growth channels. You know where customers drop off, what drives conversion, and how to turn underperforming campaigns and funnels around.

  • You have strong analytical and commercial judgment. You can look beyond surface-level metrics, challenge assumptions, and make informed decisions about where to invest, optimize, or change course.

  • You understand SEO and how AI-driven search (GEO) is changing customer discovery and influencing organic acquisition.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You've built or directed AI-enabled workflows, including agentic processes, and can demonstrate their impact on marketing performance, quality, or efficiency.

  • You have exceptional written English and demonstrated editorial experience, including final responsibility for reviewing, refining, and approving marketing copy produced by agencies, specialists, and AI. You recognize messaging that converts and ensure content meets standards for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and brand voice.

  • You've directed agencies, vendors, and external specialists, holding them accountable for results. You can challenge recommendations and creative that miss the mark, work independently, and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining strategic alignment.

Experience in SaaS, self-service acquisition, and sales-led conversion is preferred. Deep backend development skills aren't required.

How Success Is Measured

Outcome

What Success Looks Like

  • Conversion Growth: Higher conversion rates from visitor to trial to paid account across paid and organic channels.

  • Organic Visibility & Volume: Growth in organic traffic, search rankings and presence in AI answers (SEO and GEO), with organic conversions and NPUs rising alongside it.

  • Revenue Contribution: Growth in marketing-sourced revenue and new producing units (NPUs).

  • Strategic Impact & Decision Quality: Identifies material growth opportunities, develops evidence-based recommendations, influences investment and execution priorities, and demonstrates measurable improvement in commercial outcomes.

  • Acquisition Efficiency: Lower cost per customer and better return on marketing investment.

  • Campaign & Partner Performance: Agencies, the SEO vendor, offshore specialists and AI agents delivering against clear conversion goals.

  • Operational Leverage: AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, quality and cost of campaign execution and optimization.

  • Measurement & Lead Quality: Reliable attribution and dashboards, better lead quality, and stronger sales conversion.

What We Offer

We're a fully remote company, with employees working from their approved home locations. We recognize that flexibility matters, so we also allow temporary work from other locations or time zones, subject to advance approval.

Benefits designed to support you

We offer competitive compensation, meaningful benefits, and time away from work to recharge. Here are a few highlights:

  • Healthcare on us: We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees, plus 70% of dependent medical premiums.

  • Remote-work support: Up to $375 per month(4,500 annually) in eligible reimbursements, a $500 home office setup allowance, and company-provided equipment.

  • Time to truly disconnect: Flexible PTO, paid holidays, a company-wide closure between Christmas and New Year's, and a dedicated Mental Health Disconnect Day every quarter.

  • Support for growing families: Fertility and family-building benefits, plus up to $2,000 in eligible new-parent support.

  • A stake in our future: Incentive Stock Options (ISOs), subject to eligibility and grant approval, and access to a 401(k) retirement savings plan.

  • Room to keep growing: Up to $1,000 annually in professional development reimbursement, based on role level.

  • A little extra convenience: Complimentary DoorDash DashPass membership.

Compensation is determined by role, location, demonstrated capabilities, and experience. Temporary work location changes require advance approval under company policy. Benefits, equity awards, and reimbursements are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, approvals, and company policies.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At EZ Texting, we believe different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us better. We're committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people are respected, have opportunities to contribute, and are evaluated based on their skills, qualifications, and performance.

We're an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status, characteristic, identity, association, or activity, whether actual or perceived, under applicable federal, state, or local law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, advancement, and separation.

We're also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process for candidates with disabilities. If you need an accommodation, please let our recruiting team know.
